headline: T&R Law Offices advises No Filter on pre-seed fundraise
sum: No Filter, a health-focused fresh juice brand, has raised capital from a pre-seed round of funding. T&R Law Offices advised No Filter on this fundraise.
detail: No Filter, a health-focused fresh juice brand, has raised capital from a pre-seed round of funding. T&R Law Offices advised No Filter on this fundraise. The transaction team consisted of Tejbir Singh (Founding & Managing Partner), Akshay Garg (Associate) and Rayyan Yaseen (Associate Trainee). No Filter Founded by Varun Gosain, No Filter offers 100% real fruit juice with no added sugar, preservatives, or artificial concentrates, packaged in eco-friendly glass bottles.

sources.name: Bar & Bench - Dealstreet
